title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
summary: Browser maker Opera has introduced a new web standard that lets users to run AI models directly in its browser, without relying on the cloud. WebAI grew out of previous work by Opera to bring locally run models into its browsers.
